title: RISE: Recursive Improvement via Self-Extrapolating Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.05295v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense, per-token supervision for language model post-training, but its effectiveness is bottlenecked by teacher quality: external teachers suffer from distribution mismatch, while self-distillation with privileged conditioning is limited by in-context learning capacity. We propose \textbf{RISE} (\textbf{R}ecursive \textbf{I}mprovement via \textbf{S}elf-\textbf{E}xtrapolating Policy Distillation), which constructs a synthetic teacher directly from the model's own RLVR training trajectory. By extrapolating the displacement between the current checkpoint and a trailing anchor---in parameter space or output logit space---RISE converts a sparse outcome-induced parameter update into a dense token-level target, without any external model or privileged conditioning. translated_title: RISE：通过自外推策略蒸馏实现递归改进
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）为语言模型后训练提供了密集的逐token监督，但其有效性受限于教师模型的质量：外部教师模型存在分布不匹配问题，而基于特权条件的自蒸馏则受限于上下文学习能力。我们提出了RISE（通过自外推策略蒸馏实现递归改进），该方法直接从模型自身的RLVR训练轨迹构建合成教师模型。通过在参数空间或输出logit空间中外推当前检查点与尾随锚点之间的位移，RISE将稀疏的结果导向参数更新转换为密集的token级目标，而无需任何外部模型或特权条件。RISE将RLVR和OPD结合在一个互补循环中：结果奖励使外推锚定于正确推理方向，而外推得到的教师模型则……
tldr: RISE提出直接从模型自身的RLVR训练轨迹外推构建合成教师，无需外部模型或特权条件，即可将稀疏的结果奖励转换为密集的token级蒸馏目标，形成强化学习与在线策略蒸馏的互补循环。
en_tdlr: RISE constructs a synthetic teacher by extrapolating from the model's own RLVR training trajectory, converting sparse outcome rewards into dense token-level distillation targets without any external model or privileged conditioning, enabling a complementary RLVR-OPD loop.
